findings.text: LocalFlags no longer includes global flag.CommandLine flags for root commands; a flag defined via flag.StringVar(&v, "config", "") will not be found by rootCmd.LocalFlags().Lookup("config")
mergePersistentFlags no longer merges global flag.CommandLine flags into command flags; a flag defined via flag.Bool("verbose", false, "") will not be recognized when parsing command arguments

0.reason: The change removes the special handling of flag.CommandLine in LocalFlags, so global flags are no longer included, which is the same root cause as the reference bug about local flags being omitted.

1.reason: The change removes the merging of flag.CommandLine into persistent flags in mergePersistentFlags, so global flags are no longer recognized, which is the same root cause as the reference bug about flags being omitted.
